checks: Natural expiry preselects sale for every fish without payment; departure remains blocked until one explicit checkout pays the full batch
Explicit pending decisions remain supported and survive reload; incomplete stopped batches never settle partially
Mixed checkout pays exact sales and release XP, stocks the pond, empties all fish and cannot repeat rewards
Over-capacity pond transfers reject the whole batch before any sale, release, XP, fish or history mutation
Reload preserves individual release and pond overrides plus default sales without paying or losing fish before checkout
Old carried trophy fish and obsolete keep choices migrate to default sale without automatic payout; release remains an explicit override
A running-session batch processes all default sales and explicit overrides, leaving no fish to carry after an immediate stop
Offline completion preselects sale without paying; reloading cannot replay catches and checkout still clears the departure gate
